# LocalMatal

> A collaborative chain of places connected by language. Each place in the chain shares at least one feeling, image, or idea with the one before it.

LocalMatal is a slow, human-made collection of real places around the world. Contributors photograph a place that matters to them and write one sentence describing it. That sentence must share a concept — a feeling, a concrete image, or an idea — with the sentence written by the previous contributor. The result is a chain of places linked by language, not geography.

## How it works

- The homepage shows the current place at the end of the chain.
- Each place has a permanent URL at /place/{id}.
- Contributors submit a new place via /submit. Submissions are moderated before joining the chain.
- The full chain is browsable at /gallery.
- A machine-readable feed is available at /feed.xml (RSS 2.0).
- A sitemap of all approved places is at /sitemap.xml.

## Content

- All place descriptions are original, human-written sentences.
- Each sentence is semantically connected to the one before it in the chain.
- Places include a photograph, a place name, a one-sentence description, and an approximate location.
- Contributor names are displayed alongside each place.
- Exact GPS coordinates are fuzzy for contributor privacy.

## What is not here

- No advertising or tracking.
- No algorithmically generated content.
- The /admin, /api, and /pending paths are not public.

## Contact

For content removal requests or questions, see the Privacy Policy at /privacy.
